thread:
ops-tilly: Heads up — H100 shipment (AWB 123-45678901) is being held at FRA customs. Packing list shows serials A1001-A1032 but the pallet check found A1001-A1028 + 4 unverified units. Customs asked for manufacturer serial list + HS code documentation. Holding status: 'pending paperwork'. Can vendor push corrected manifest and an estimated release ETA?

nexa-logistics: Sorry for the hassle — we see the transposition. Our packing team mis-typed 4 serials during consolidation. We're pulling the original manufacturer manifest and COO now. Case opened: RMA-789-2024. I'll upload corrected docs and notify broker immediately.

sam-procure: If customs insists on returning those 4, what's the lead time for replacements? We have two critical scale events starting tomorrow.

jordan-infra: Also need to know if partial release to eu-west1 is possible — we can bring the rest online if we get at least 24 GPUs.

nexa-logistics: Replacement options: a) Corrected manifest + priority customs release (~4–8 hrs if broker escalates), b) RMA return + resend (5–7 business days), c) Split AWB + partial release (possible, but requires expedite fee €450 + customs admin). We can offer loaner H100s from our EU pool for up to 7 days at €120/day/unit while the RMA completes.

maya-legal: Looping in customs broker @klaus-broker — please confirm if corrected docs will be sufficient for priority release or if an inspection will still be triggered. Also need to review any liability for loaners.

klaus-broker: If you can push corrected manifest and COO with manufacturer serials and invoice showing HS code 8471.80, we can request priority processing. No guarantee — customs may still open inspection if serial audit flags persist, but priority escalations typically shorten hold to 4–6 hrs. Storage fees if inspection: ~€65/day/pallet.

ops-tilly: Thanks. Nexa, please send: corrected packing list (CSV), COO PDF, proforma with HS code 8471.80, and the manufacturer serial list. Also include the updated AWB reference if you re-issue.

nexa-logistics: Uploading now — link: https://files.nexa.example/manifest_1714682025.pdf . Updated AWB: 123-45678901-v2. We've attached manifest CSV and COO. RMA case RMA-789-2024 updated with notes: 4 serials transposed, request partial release.

sam-procure: If we take loaners, need SLA terms: uptime, liability for damage, and whether loaners count against committed capacity.

nexa-logistics: Loaner terms (summary): vendor covers hardware defects; customer covers physical damage in custody and shipping back. Loaners are tagged as temporary and do not count toward committed capacity—billing is per-day. We can sign a short addendum today.

jordan-infra: If loaners arrive, we can hot-swap at the node level and reimage. Need serial list + tracking. Also want to reserve a routing slot to eu-west1; please confirm warehouse ETA.

nexa-logistics: Warehouse pickable in ~2 hrs from DE depot for loaners. ETA to eu-west1 DC via next-day courier. We'll send tracking and serials once picked.

maya-legal: I'll review the addendum and confirm we can accept liability language. @ops-tilly please hold on signing until I give a thumbs-up.

ops-tilly: Copy. Klaus, please escalate priority release with customs once you have the corrected manifest.

klaus-broker: Escalation submitted. Reference: CBX-54321. If customs accepts the manifest, expect partial release for 28 units within ~6 hours. If they request inspection, expect 24–48 hours + storage.

nexa-logistics: Confirmed — manifest corrected, COO attached, AWB v2 active, loaners reserved. RMA-789-2024 will track the four affected serials and replacement shipment if required. Will update with tracking in this thread in 30–45 min.

ops-tilly: Great — please ping here when tracking is live. :thumbsup:

sam-procure: If this drags, let's prepare a contingency PO for temporary loaners to avoid capacity shortfall. I'll draft and circulate.

jordan-infra: Once loaner serials are in, I'll schedule smoke tests and mark nodes for replacement when originals clear customs.

nexa-logistics: Update: tracking for loaners assigned: DE-LN-98234, expected pick-up 1714689200, courier ETA eu-west1 1714775600. RMA-789-2024: replacement shipment quoting 5 business days if RMA is required.

ops-tilly: Acknowledged. Keeping this thread as single source of truth. Will escalate to oncall if ETA slides.

nexa-logistics: Final note — expedite fee only if customer requests split AWB partial release; otherwise we proceed with corrected manifest route.

ops-tilly: Understood. We'll wait on broker confirmation first. Thanks everyone.
